subject.title: Feature request: Shareable cron job templates

question: Should scheduled automations become a first-class ClawHub package family, a constrained extension of an existing family, or remain manual skill-guided setup until OpenClaw exposes a safe importer?
rationale: Current schemas have no scheduled-job artifact, and the choice affects catalog APIs, moderation, scanning, compatibility, installation consent, updates, and the OpenClaw runtime boundary.

options.title: Specify first-class templates
options.body: Create a structured automation-template package with preview, moderation, explicit consent, update, and uninstall semantics before implementation.

options.title: Keep manual skill recipes
options.body: Improve discovery of skills that teach cron setup while users continue creating recurring jobs themselves.

options.title: Extend bundle plugins
options.body: Reuse bundle plugins only after maintainers approve compatible manifest, trust, consent, and lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Specify first-class templates
recommendation.body: Create a structured automation-template package with preview, moderation, explicit consent, update, and uninstall semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history connects this person most directly to package schemas, plugin planning, scanning, and installability policy.
